title: Manlapud Kaaraleman na Bobon
intro: Say biahe na sakey a malangwer a kamarerwa so ginmapo ed sakey a mabiskeg a pasingawey na saray mangatatawen a bengatla ya onkukurong bilang panaggalang. Say bilay na sayan indibidual et atandaan na sankagrabian ya panagtraidor na saray sankaasinggeran to, ya tinumbokan na dakel a taon ya inkaaripen tan ag manepeg ya inkapriso. Balet diad panamegley na ag-onkupas a pananisia tan madibinon panangigiya, sayan pigura so inmalagey manlapud sankaabebaan a abot pian magmaliw a sakey ed saray sankabiskegan a totoo ed sakey a baleg ya empiryo. Sarag mon naamtaan no siopa iyan makapadinayew ya lingkor nen Allah?
clues: Nipanengneng ed siak so pasingawey na labin-sakey a bitewen, say banwa, tan say bulan ya akatalimukor ed arap ko
Siak so inad-aro a tuloy ya anak na ateng ko, a sengegan na imon na saray agagik
inerel da ak na saray mismon agagik, nilakseb da ak, tan imbantak da ak ed aralem tan ambilunget a bobon
Inlako da ak bilang lakoan ed sakey a tindaan tan inawit da ak ya arawi ed binalegan kon bansa
Sakey a makapanyarin bii so nanggunaet a mangikompromiso ed kagalangan ko, tan siak so nipriso lapud agko inawat so iyaabuloy to
Abendisyonan ak na regalon pangiter na kabaliksan na kugip, tan inmalagey ak manlapud sakey a nilingwanan a priso ya anggad nagmaliw a manunan ministro na Ehipto

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Ibantak na saray agagi to ed aralem a bobon
Makaliktar ed baleg a delap ed interon mundo
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya hurnoan
Milalaban ed sakey a higanten mibabakal diad sakey a pasen na bakal
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
trial.answer: Ibantak na saray agagi to ed aralem a bobon

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Aralem tan amagan bobon ed kalawakan
Sakey a baleg a biong a gawad kiew ed toktok na palandey
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a makapadinayew a trono na baleg a kagalangan
Sakey a tirador tan limaran makinis a bato
location.answer: Aralem tan amagan bobon ed kalawakan

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Inmalis ed chief minister na Egypt tan akapiulop lamet ed inad-aro ton pamilya
Nanggawa na baleg a barko tan tinawag to ray totoo ed pananisia
Inwanwan to so interon nasyon ya ompaway ed inkaaripen ed Ehipto
Naikdan na panarian tan pananguley ed ag nanengneng
Naikdan na anos ed graben sakit tan inmabig
outcome.answer: Inmalis ed chief minister na Egypt tan akapiulop lamet ed inad-aro ton pamilya

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
